---

```{r paths, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("01_code", "_paths.R"))
source(file.path(repo_root, "tools", "plot_style.R"))   # shared colours: red up, blue down
dir.create(file.path(top, "Top_50_genes"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

For each TC contrast: the 25 most up- and 25 most down-regulated DEGs that have a UniProt hit
(fewer on a side with fewer), written to `03_analyses/top_DEGs/Top_50_genes/<code>_topgenes.csv`
and drawn as `<code>_top50.png`, each bar labelled with the gene symbol of the best hit.

### Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)      # read_csv (the script did not load it; it only ran in sessions with tidyverse attached)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```

### Load DEGS
```{r}
# Gill (TC)
GOW_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GOW_sigs_ID.csv"))
GOA_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GOA_sigs_ID.csv"))
GDO_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GDO_sigs_ID.csv"))

# Foot (TC)
FOW_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FOW_sigs_ID.csv"))
FOA_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FOA_sigs_ID.csv"))
FDO_sigs_ID<- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FDO_sigs_ID.csv"))

# One row per gene: its best UniProt hit (highest bitscore; ties in table order), the rule 07
# and 09 use. A gene with several hits (one per transcript) used to be labelled by whichever
# hit came first in the table, which for LOC134695253 in GDO was not the best one.
# Bar label: the gene symbol of the best UniProt hit, upper-cased so the label does not carry
# the matched species' case convention, or a short protein name where UniProt gives none.
# UniProt's gene-name field also holds locus tags (MCOR_42823, a M. coruscus locus that is
# the byssal adhesive ACDC; ZK1073.1, CG8399, AAEL007634, SPBC18H10.09); the first name that
# is not a locus tag is used, and the protein name if every name is one.
LOCUS_TAG_RX <- "_[0-9]+$|^[A-Za-z0-9]+\\.[0-9]+[a-z]?$|^CG[0-9]+$|^[A-Z]{2,}[0-9]{4,}$"
gene_symbol <- function(gene_name, protein_name) {
  names_list <- strsplit(trimws(ifelse(is.na(gene_name), "", gene_name)), " +")
  sym <- vapply(names_list, function(n) {
    n <- n[nzchar(n) & !grepl(LOCUS_TAG_RX, n)]
    if (length(n)) toupper(n[1]) else ""
  }, "")
  ifelse(nzchar(sym), sym, short_name(protein_name, 36))
}
best_hit <- function(d) d %>% arrange(desc(bitscore)) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(gene_symbol = gene_symbol(gene_name, protein_name))
GOW_sigs_ID<- best_hit(GOW_sigs_ID)
GOA_sigs_ID<- best_hit(GOA_sigs_ID)
GDO_sigs_ID<- best_hit(GDO_sigs_ID)

FOW_sigs_ID<- best_hit(FOW_sigs_ID)
FOA_sigs_ID<- best_hit(FOA_sigs_ID)
FDO_sigs_ID<- best_hit(FDO_sigs_ID)


```


```{r helpers}
# Where two genes in one plot share a label, the LOC ID is added. `geneID` (the entry-name
# mnemonic, e.g. CO6A3 for COL6A3) is kept in the table but no longer used as a label.
bar_labels <- function(d) {
  lab <- d$gene_symbol
  dup <- duplicated(lab) | duplicated(lab, fromLast = TRUE)
  lab[dup] <- paste0(lab[dup], " (", d$LOC_ID[dup], ")")
  setNames(lab, as.character(d$gene))
}
TISSUE_OF <- c(F = "Foot", G = "Gill")
plot_top <- function(top_genes, code) {
  p <- ggplot(top_genes, aes(x = gene, y = log2FoldChange, fill = log2FoldChange > 0)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = DIRECTION_COLORS[["down"]], "TRUE" = DIRECTION_COLORS[["up"]]),
                      labels = c("FALSE" = "Down-regulated", "TRUE" = "Up-regulated"), name = NULL) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = bar_labels(top_genes)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(Log[2]*" fold change (apeglm)"),
         title = sprintf("%s %s vs day-3 control: largest annotated DEGs", TISSUE_OF[[substr(code, 1, 1)]],
                         substr(code, 2, 3)),
         caption = paste(strwrap(paste(
           "Up to 25 up- and 25 down-regulated DEGs (padj < 0.05) with a UniProt hit, by fold change. Labels:",
           "gene symbol of the best hit (upper-cased), or a protein name where UniProt gives none; the LOC ID",
           "is added where two genes share a label."), width = 95), collapse = "\n")) +
    theme_psmfc(10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
          plot.caption.position = "plot", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  ggsave(file.path(top, "Top_50_genes", paste0(code, "_top50.png")), p,
         width = 7, height = 1.8 + 0.17 * nrow(top_genes), dpi = 300)
  p
}
```
# GOW 
```{r}

# Sample DEG dataframe (Replace with your actual data)
# Assume 'deg_results' contains 'gene', 'log2FoldChange', and 'padj'
GOW_top <- GOW_sigs_ID %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))


# Extract top 25 upregulated and downregulated genes (by sign, so a contrast with fewer than
# 25 genes on one side does not fill that side with genes from the other)
top_up <- GOW_top %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 25)
top_down <- GOW_top %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% arrange(log2FoldChange) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 25)

# Combine both subsets
top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

# Set factor levels in REVERSE order to ensure positive log2FC is at the top in coord_flip()
top_genes <- top_genes %>%arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
top_genes$gene <- factor(top_genes$gene, levels = rev(top_genes$gene))

write.csv(top_genes, file.path(top, "Top_50_genes", "GOW_topgenes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

plot_top(top_genes, "GOW")
```
